title: Four-body additivity: rectangle 3x4 with species A,B,C,A
pitch: Four-body additivity in one run. Rectangle 3 x 4 at rest, species A,B,C,A: sides 3 and 4, diagonals 5, so every pair sits at a separation we have measured (3, 4, 5). The pairwise-additive integration of our sep-3/4/5 table predicts the whole trajectory set. Three-body triangle (r3/006) already matched within noise. Falsified if any particle deviates from the pairwise sum by more than 0.05 per coordinate over t<=1.0.
